description:
Cast Suspension Field by paying {1}{W}.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Leonin Relic-Warder to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Suspension Field.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Suspension Field to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
